spec_coverage.notes: ZERO findings. Every §12 test-plan item has corresponding falsifiable coverage in the diff, and every spec change traces to §12 or an adjudicated ruling. AUTH DELTA VERIFIED AS REAL COVERAGE (not ghost): (1) 'hiring-team member without AI-credits control' context creates HiringTeamMembership.create!(organization_user:, job: job_record) putting a role: :org_user (non-admin, verified enum org_user:0) org_user on the job's hiring team, and sets hiring_team_ai_credits_control_enabled=>false. Job#users is through: :organization_users through: :hiring_team_memberships, and OrganizationUser#jobs is through: :hiring_team_memberships (job.rb:46-50, organization_user.rb:14-15), so JobPolicy#update? (=on_hiring_team? = is_org_admin? || record.users.include?(user), job_policy.rb:20-22,58-60) is genuinely true. It asserts 200 on BOTH show and create. This 'allows create' assertion is a genuine regression guard against reverting to the OLD update_ai_settings? gate: with hiring_team_ai_credits_control_enabled=false, AiJobApplicationSummaryPolicy#can_use_ai_credits? = is_org_admin? || (is_org_user? && hiring_team_ai_credits_control_enabled?) = false||false = false, so update_ai_settings? would 403 -> the test would FAIL under the old gate. Setting is load-bearing. (2) The outsider context creates NO HiringTeamMembership; update? is false -> Pundit::NotAuthorizedError -> user_not_authorized renders 403 (application_controller.rb:10,15-17). Mentally deleting authorize job, :update? from #create: outsider create would proceed (Flipper enabled, description present via create_credit_test_job default 'Test job description') and return 200, so the 403 assertion FAILS -> not a ghost test. Note: update? and show? have the SAME effective set here (hiring-team member OR admin), so no test can behaviorally distinguish them; this is inherent, not a coverage gap (DECISIONS/§9: 'same effective set'). NOTE ON §12 STALENESS: §12 line 513 still says the member is 'rejected on create' (pre-auth-change wording); the implementation correctly follows the amended §9/DECISIONS (member ALLOWED on create). Per the BRIEF authority chain this matching implementation is adjudicated and NOT a finding; the §12 line-513 wording is stale spec text, not a test defect. GHOST-TEST SWEEP (rule 26): no reflection-only assertions, no instance_method/rescue_handlers checks, no assigned-but-never-asserted vars, no always-true type checks. retry_on is tested BEHAVIORALLY (extract_job_criteria_job_spec exhaustion example uses perform_enqueued_jobs, asserts row 'failed' + broadcast; the non-exhausted CustomErrorAiSummary case asserts have_enqueued_job + no broadcast). Mailer delivery verified per pipeline rule 4 (instance_double(ActionMailer::MessageDelivery) + have_received(:deliver_later)) in bulk_generate zero-criteria batch.
